title: Echoboard: per-route rollout drift diagnoser and live shadow playback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a new Console feature (Echoboard) that surfaces divergence and root-cause signals between rollout cohorts: per-route metric diffs, session-level trace links, a live shadow playback inspector for sampled traffic, and an automated divergence scoring signal that can be wired to auto-rollback policies. This ticket covers product spec, telemetry contracts, and acceptance criteria for a minimal first release (read-only dashboard + sampled shadow playback).
acceptance_criteria: Console has an Echoboard dashboard accessible from any rollout with at least two variants showing: per-route token-level latency histograms, success/error rates, and embedding similarity deltas between cohorts
Trace links from cohort-differential rows navigate to the trace viewer pre-filtered to the selected session and variant
Live shadow playback UI can replay a sampled sequence of requests (request, model response, routing metadata) for up to 200 requests per rollout and supports playback at 1x/2x speed
A numeric divergence_score (0-100) is computed every 5 minutes per route using a weighted blend of latency regression, output divergence (embedding cosine drop), and error-rate delta
Divergence_score can be surfaced as an alert and exposed to rollout policies for auto-rollback with configurable threshold and minimum sample size
Telemetry and storage costs estimated and validated with infra; sampling defaults to 0.5% of global traffic for Echoboard playback
Design review completed and engineering sign-off on data retention and PII-safe redaction rules
comments: 2026-02-11 @Marco Liu: Scoped initial PoC: dashboard + divergence signal only. Playback will be a follow-up if PoC telemetry volume estimate is acceptable.

2026-02-28 @Aisha Patel: Product review meeting notes — prefer conservative defaults: divergence threshold = 30, min_sample_size = 1000, sampling = 0.5%. Captured in notes doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Echoboard+Spec
2026-03-02 @Marco Liu: Backend schema proposal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/432. Includes new metric 'output_embedding_cosine' and 'kv_cache_hit_ratio' fields.
2026-03-05 @Thomas Park (Security): Reviewed redaction strategy for request payloads. Approved PII-safe playback for sampled inputs with regex-based masking. See security review ticket SEC-1127.

2026-03-10 @Elena V. (SRE): Load test summary — Echoboard telemetry ingestion at 0.5% sampling increases write QPS by ~2.8% on ingestion path; no impact on serving nodes observed. Load test results: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/shared/echo-ingest-loadtest

2026-03-12 @Marco Liu: Implementation note — initial rollout will be read-only. Auto-rollback hook will be behind a feature flag and gated to Dedicated customers. Follow-up ticket will add rollback orchestration and canary policy editor integration.
decisions: Use a composite divergence_score combining: (40%) embedding cosine drop, (35%) p95 latency regression adjusted for KV-cache-hit, (25%) error-rate delta
Playback sampling capped at 0.5% globally to balance observability with cost
Echoboard initially read-only; rollback actions require explicit enablement and policy configuration in a later release
Session-level traces are stored for 7 days by default for Echoboard; longer retention available as a paid add-on
